title: decision: one HPKE external-receiver key per hub, not per room
description:
Mark 2026-11-26. For bead mimid-1wgh.4.79.2: the hub publishes an HPKE
public key in each room's external_receivers (semiprivatemessage-08 §3),
and that key has to come from somewhere.

## The readings

1. One key pair per hub, stored beside the signature key and the
   franking key in `hub_secret`. Chosen.
2. One key pair per room, stored in the `room` row.

## Why per hub

The hub is one party with one identity. Its entry in a room's
external_receivers is `{ HPKEPublicKey, Credential }`, and the Credential
is the hub's; a different public key per room under the same Credential
says nothing new about who is reading.

The compartment per-room keys would buy is illusory here. Every private
key lives unencrypted in the same SQLite file -- `store::keys` says so
in its own Limitations -- so a leak that exposes one room's key exposes
them all. Per-room keys would be compartments inside one box, paid for
with a key pair, a column and an AppDataUpdate per room.

Per hub also matches what is already there: one signature key pair and
one franking HMAC key for the whole hub, in one row.

## What this gives up, stated

A single key for every room means one compromise reads every room's
handshakes rather than one room's. That is the same exposure the
franking key already has, and the same exposure the signature key has,
so it does not widen the blast radius of a hub compromise -- a hub that
leaks its database has lost its rooms anyway.

If per-room keys are ever wanted, the migration is additive: a nullable
column on `room`, with the hub key as the fallback for rooms that have
none.

## Consequences

- `hub_secret` gains `hpke_private_key` and `hpke_public_key`, generated
  with the other secrets on first use.
- `StoredHubSecret`'s Debug keeps printing only public material.
- Rotating the key is not possible today. This decision assumed an
  AppDataUpdate per room would do it; it will not, because
  is_known_component does not cover 0x0007, so such an update is
  refused, and GroupContextExtensions proposals are refused outright.
  external_receivers is set at room creation and fixed after. Corrected
  2026-11-26 after a code review; bead mimid-1wgh.4.79.12 holds what
  has to be decided to make rotation work.
